site.name: Guruprasad Karanam
site.intro: A collection of working demos — integration processes, real-time APIs and the web front ends that use them. Each project lives in its own folder under /projects.

projects.title: Boomi Platform Message Estimator (presales sizing tool)
projects.summary: A presales calculator that turns workload inputs (integration interfaces, EDI partners, API calls, Control Plane APIs, event topics, Flow apps, Data Hub golden records, Data Integration pipelines and AI agents) into estimated Boomi Platform Messages per month and per year. It projects volume over the contract term with growth and headroom so the AE can choose the platform, and has a second mode that counts connection licences by connector class.
highlights: Per-row message math with hover explanations and editable conversion rates
Data Integration BDU builder, one-time initial loads, Control Plane and Agentstudio sizing
Save/open scenarios as JSON, export CSV, print a PDF summary; runs fully in the browser

projects.title: Teras Connect - legacy data to governed AI tools (Boomi OEM demo)
projects.summary: A multi-tenant console for Aras Integrasi × MTAI that turns legacy systems into governed AI tools. JPJ's IBM P-Series (IBM i DB2) vehicle, licence and summons data flows through Boomi, which cleanses it, masks personal data by data classification and publishes it as agent tools and RAG knowledge. A switch runs every call on either an on-premise (sovereign) or a Boomi cloud runtime.
highlights: IBM P-Series records reached through Boomi, with cleansing on input and PII governance on output
Live agent tools (vehicle, licence, summons) and a virtual assistant with cited answers
On-prem vs cloud runtime switch on every call; tenant onboarding, connection and mapping reuse

projects.title: Copperleaf Provisions - AP Invoice 3-Way Match
projects.summary: Upload a vendor invoice PDF and watch a Boomi process match it against the purchase order and goods receipts: quantity, unit price and line value with tolerances, then approval for payment or routing to the AP exception queue. Includes a matching dashboard and seven sample invoices.
highlights: PDF text extraction in a Node gateway; matching runs in a Boomi API Service
Mock ERP and WMS subprocesses (split, filter, combine) ready to swap for real connectors
Live step view replayed from the Boomi execution's own timestamps

projects.title: Copperleaf Provisions — Operations Portal
projects.summary: A sales and master-data portal for a fictitious fine-food wholesaler. Every screen is backed by Boomi real-time APIs that call the Northwind OData V2 service: a KPI dashboard with charts, orders with printable invoices, product order insight, customers, suppliers and employees.
highlights: 8 REST routes on one Boomi API Service, each a listener + testable subprocess
Dashboard process fans out to 11 OData queries with a Branch step
Runs live: GitHub Pages front end calls a Railway-hosted gateway that holds the Boomi credentials
